dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Tsk, look, I know they're not much to look at, but these here Sunsettias hold a profound and mysterious secret...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: ...If you were to try one, then you would know: they're much sweeter than most other Sunsettias.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: In fact, you can take these ones. Then you'll see I'm telling the truth...
